title: Can I DEFEAT Ouroboros King?
summary: Ouroboros King 'defeat' run reaching the final bosses (Ouroboros trio) via Ridge of Ruin; General unit card shown.
rules: Ouroboros King (Steam 'tactical variant chess roguelite'): campaign through regions (Kingdom of Thessalonia, Marsh of Madness, Ridge of Ruin) on a node map; nodes include Training Grounds (recruit units), Ruins (relics = permanent bonuses), battles, Armory (upgrade one unit), shop, final boss.
Start with your King and recruit units from offered choices, placing them on your side; armies are small (e.g. King + Rook + Glass Queen + Viking).

Unit examples: Rook (orthogonal any distance); Portal Mage (move to any unoccupied square, kills only adjacent); Reaper (moves like a king, kills any enemy on a same-colour tile that is not a king or witch); Glass Queen (queen; if she dies she never returns in future combats; upgrades to Mirror Queen); Marching Pawn (moves 2 forward or 1 diagonally forward, kills diagonally, becomes a queen on the last row for that combat; upgrades to Quartermaster); Prince (moves like a king; your king can't be killed while within 3 squares of him); Knight; Fool (moves with the same pattern as the last enemy move); Viking (move up to two times orthogonally, directions may differ; upgrades to Berserker); General (enemy/your royal: moves 1 square any direction; if killed his army surrenders).

Relics: The Finisher (if the enemy king/general is alone and you have other units at the start of your turn, you win), Alarm Bell (alarm when your king is in danger), Ouroboros Sigil (+1 rewind at start of each battle); rewinds undo moves (e.g. 3-6 per battle); relics can be sacrificed.
Battle win: capture the enemy king/general (or Finisher condition); AI may offer draws; units have gold costs that rise (Reaper 481 gold).
win_condition: Win battles by killing the enemy General/king units; clear the campaign and defeat the Ouroboros final bosses.
